data.description:
## Description
**What**: Add the config key review.atomicity_inference_enabled (default false), documented in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md, that gates only the Category 8 LLM-inference pass; the deterministic registry pass always runs. LLM-inferred findings carry confidence: advisory.
**Why**: The inference pass fires non-deterministically across runs; a toggle plus advisory confidence keeps the deterministic registry authoritative while letting operators disable inference.
**Scope**:
- IN: review.atomicity_inference_enabled key (default false); the LLM-inference pass emitting confidence: advisory findings gated by the key; CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md documentation of this key and registry.antipattern_path.
- OUT: the deterministic registry pass (draft-5), which always runs regardless of this key.

## Done Definitions

- With review.atomicity_inference_enabled false a planning run emits zero confidence advisory findings but still emits registry-backed findings ← Satisfies: sc-8
- With review.atomicity_inference_enabled true the LLM-inference pass emits findings carrying confidence advisory ← Satisfies: sc-8
- review.atomicity_inference_enabled and registry.antipattern_path are documented in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md with description, type, default, and scope ← Validates Closure Check: "review.atomicity_inference_enabled and registry.antipattern_path are documented in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md."
- Unit tests written and passing for the gated inference pass in both the key-false and key-true states ← Satisfies: sc-8

## Considerations

- [Sequencing] This story depends on the SC4 paired-doc story (draft-4) so the key documentation follows the established config-key/doc pairing pattern, and on draft-5 which owns the deterministic registry pass this key sits beside.
- [Build] New .sh files set the executable bit (chmod +x) on creation.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO operator, I want a config key that gates only the Category 8 LLM-inference pass, so that non-deterministic advisory findings can be disabled while registry findings always run.
